target_customer: Independent speech-language pathologists (supply side) and individuals and care organizations needing speech therapy (demand side)
problem: SLPs burn out on administration, insurance and marketing, while patients struggle to find in-network speech therapy.
business_model: Therapy practice enablement with insurance billing, taking a share of therapy revenue; AI back office
product_category: Digital health speech therapy network and practice back office

founders.name: Adam Steinle
founders.background_notes: Former biomedical engineer, banker and product manager; four years at Facebook on content moderation, community growth, gaming and creator monetization.

founders.name: Danielle Yoesep
previous_startups: Helped spin out a company later acquired
founders.background_notes: Science background including research on platform technologies for synthesizing molecules.

founders.name: Shuying Zhang
founders.background_notes: Biomedical engineering and software background; Document AI, knowledge graphs and cloud work.

competitors.name: Expressable
competitors.what: Online one-on-one speech therapy with SLPs, insurance and private pay
competitors.funding_then: Seed of 4.5M in 2021 per press release

competitors.name: TheraPlatform
competitors.what: Practice management, EHR and teletherapy software for private practice therapists

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly marketplace operations, insurance credentialing and billing workflow, with AI documentation as a modest layer.

defensibility.rationale: Insurance in-network contracts and a therapist supply base help, but competitors like Expressable already had both.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Verse was acquired by Beaming Health in December 2025 per PitchBook; its site now directs to that company.

market_need_then: Widely reported SLP shortage and burnout, strong demand for in-network therapy; company claimed 10 states and 35 therapists by its YC launch.

branding.domain_note: versetherapy.com; now redirects to a Beaming Health notice per a search summary.

rebrands.why: Acquired; site now says Verse Therapy joined Beaming Health

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community coverage of the brand found; small regional brand with a generic name.

outcome_analysis: Verse Therapy joined YC in Winter 2024 to help SLPs run independent practices and was acquired by Beaming Health in December 2025 per PitchBook, with price undisclosed. With little public funding information it is unclear whether this was a strong exit or a soft landing. The acquisition suggests the network and payer relationships had value, but traction beyond the launch claims is unverified.
notes: Round added: PitchBook 500K in 2024-01, a single database entry. Prospeo says 3M in 2024-06 and a Dealroom page says 3M seed but that page is for Hona.ai, a different company; neither is recorded. Acquisition rests on PitchBook plus the site redirect; a second search found no press release.
